metadata.description: Local marketplace for the pipeline-first renmark build assistant.

plugins.name: renmark
plugins.description: Pipeline-first build assistant for Claude Code. Six pipelines — /renmark:init (adopt a repo), /renmark:start (new build), /renmark:feature (add/change), /renmark:debug (fix), /renmark:roadmap (gaps / what's next), /renmark:finish (ship) — over 27 guided commands (also prd, brainstorm, blueprint, plan, check-plan, orchestrate, verify, codereview, loop, backlog, audit, inventory, scan, approve, hygiene, doctor, setup, resume, usage, analytics, help). Persistent project memory in .renmark/.
